name: mcp-installer
stderr:
Usage: smithery [options] [command]

Smithery CLI - Manage and run MCP servers

Options:
  --verbose                           Show detailed logs
  --debug                             Show debug logs
  -h, --help                          display help for command

Commands:
  default-install [options] <server>  Install a package
  uninstall [options] <server>        Uninstall a package
  inspect [options] <server>          Inspect server from registry
  run [options] <server>              Run a server
  dev [options] [entryFile]           Start development server with hot-reload
                                      and tunnel
  build [options] [entryFile]         Build MCP server for production
  playground [options]                Open MCP playground in browser
  list [options] <type>               List available resources
  login                               Login with an API key
  install [options] <qualifiedName>   Install a package for a specific client
                                      (skip registry and API key checks, only
                                      local configuration)
  help [command]                      display help for command
